about: Parts of a course that are ON by default (the full version) and that the learner may turn off in the plugin (engram-quest/videos/settings.json -> course.off: [ids]). Subtraction only: nothing here can be added beyond the default, and the skeleton (reference/04-skeleton.md) is not a module and cannot be turned off. resolve.cjs prints the result as `modules`. Rules: reference/12-modules.md.

does.zh-tw: 每段收尾的那張圖自動變成一張複習卡，放進 EngramQuest 的複習排程
does.en: Each segment's recap picture becomes a review card in EngramQuest's spaced-repetition deck

cost.zh-tw: 每課 3～4 張卡；影片本身不變
cost.en: 3-4 cards per lesson; the film itself does not change
